text:
deploy-bot: Notice: dedicated pool 'pool-4' saw latency +40% and errors +0.8% after rollout. Auto-rollback withheld due to pool pin. Manual approval required.

tara_rm: Confirm pool-4 is a reserved customer pool. We must avoid touching unless emergency.

leo_ops: We can rollback per-pool without affecting others. Command: `deployctl rollback --pool pool-4 --to-version v2.9.0 --confirm`. Recommend 15m watch before action.

vicky_cs: Looping CS. If we rollback, customer note: "We're reverting a model update in your reserved pool to reduce latency. No action required." Need approval to send.

legal_bot: Contract check: clause S2a requires 24h notice for SLA-impacting changes unless emergency. Current metrics are just below emergency threshold. Legal advises conditional automation only with explicit criteria.

tara_rm: Approve conditional automation: allow emergency rollback if errors >=1% OR p95 >=800ms for 5m. Otherwise schedule rollback in the next change window (04:00 UTC) and send scheduled notice. Assign RCA to @leo_ops and @sam_sre.

deploy-bot: Observation window starts at 1777770030. If threshold hit, auto-rollback to v2.9.0 and notify CS + legal. Current: p95 472ms, errors 0.82%.

(emoji: :hourglass_flowing_sand: tara_rm, :white_check_mark: leo_ops)
